item.title: Gagarin: Why was his landing a secret for 30 years?
item.description:
Join Yuri Gagarin's cosmic expedition aboard Vostok 1 and the secret of his landing.

Gagarin returned from space enveloped in plasma, with the radio silent. But the biggest secret wasn't the reentry, but what happened in the final minutes of the landing.

Yuri Gagarin's historic Vostok 1 flight marked humanity. But why did the Soviet Union hide the true outcome of his journey for three decades? Explore the 108 minutes of a cosmic triumph, the silent reentry, and the secret behind the landing that official history erased.

⏱️ Chapters
00:00 Soviet space triumph hid a secret
02:09 The SK-1 pressure suit design
04:26 Unprecedented panorama marked human frontier
07:10 What happened during freefall?
10:04 Abrupt opening allowed cold air
13:00 Document concealed Soviet engineering vulnerability

If you enjoy exploring cosmic mysteries and NASA missions, subscribe and hit the bell. New episodes every week.

item.title: You NEVER imagined food in the time of Jesus
item.description:
Discover the surprising truth about food and survival in the time of Jesus.

Life in the first century depended on food. But what if the most basic source of life, water, was in fact a deadly threat?

Imagine a world where water was poison. In this documentary, Sacred Feather Mysteries investigates what people truly ate and drank two thousand years ago. Discover why bread was sacred and how a simple meal could decide the fate of nations, revealing the secrets of survival in ancient Galilee in the time of Jesus.

⏱️ Chapters
00:00 What people ate in biblical times
01:44 How they flavored a monotonous diet
04:37 And red meat
07:57 Why does he eat with sinners?
11:07 Obtaining food was arduous in biblical times

If you enjoy exploring the lesser-known side of the Bible, subscribe and hit the bell. New episodes every week.
